title: guideUnits
responsibility: Builds a committed-state checklist from declarations and heuristic boundaries, requiring authored tests and verified retained screenshots at every device viewport.

inputs.name: guideUnits.id
inputs.description: Registered active identity; undefined selects all only when the options explicitly request all.

inputs.name: guideUnits.options
inputs.description: Project root and optional additional required-state JSON paths. Guide reads HEAD; contract checks read the working tree. all selects every active stored contract.

inputs.name: renderUnitsGuide.report
inputs.description: Completed structured report to render without recomputing source or upgrading proof.

outputs.name: guideUnits
outputs.description: Entity and tested HEAD, ordered REQUIRED/GUESS states with reasons, authored tests, device shot status, totals, NEXT commands and proof gaps.

outputs.name: renderUnitsGuide
outputs.description: Human checklist with per-device DONE/MISSING, test files, derivation reasons, totals and executable NEXT instructions.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
